decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line changelog entry, "feat: configurable log timestamp format (#21478)" [ev-c2104d400177]. It doesn't name the setting, say what the default is, or say whether the existing log timestamp format changed. So the claim that "existing environments continue to function as before" is a guess, not something the evidence states. To decide between none and behavior-change, we need the PR #21478 description, the docs, or the upgrade guide showing whether the default format stays the same.
